blockers.wanted: a 'downpour' knob that raises the drop rate with a density claim
blockers.tried: poisson rate 120..800 mapped to the knob
blockers.workaround: capped rate range at 30..250 where the density measure still rises (it saturates near 100 events/s, then falls as ticks overlap)

blockers.wanted: true peak at or under the documented -1 dBFS ceiling
blockers.workaround: none; sample peak -1.0 dBFS but true peak +0.1 dBTP

blockers.wanted: high flatness for a rain texture together with centroid 3-8 kHz
blockers.tried: wider ticks and a pink-noise bed; full-band flatness 0.08 (0.97 in the occupied band) because content stops at the lowpass
blockers.workaround: read the occupied-band flatness (0.97); the full-band one is set by the lowpass and the wash knob barely moves it

wishlist: a rain node (drops at a rate with a surface-hiss bed) like fire/wind
a density measure that does not saturate at ~100 events/s
verify flagging true peak over the ceiling
what_worked: poisson -> voices with a $rand band-pass centre gave a steady tick texture in one call
the macro sweep on creation and verify named exactly why a claim failed
